phoebe.definition:
n. (Greek mythology) a Titaness who became identified with Artemis as goddess of the Moon
n. small dun-colored North American flycatcher
phoebe.translation: n. 福柏(月神), 月亮

phoebes.translation: （产于北美的）东菲比霸蓊, 月神, 月亮( phoebe的名词复数 )

phoebus.definition: n (Greek mythology) Greek god of light; god of prophecy and poetry and music and healing; son of Zeus and Leto; twin brother of Artemis
phoebus.translation: n. 福玻斯(日神), 太阳

phoebus apollo.translation: [网络] 阿波罗；福玻斯·阿波罗；太阳神阿波罗

phoenicia.definition: n. an ancient maritime country (a collection of city states) at eastern end of the Mediterranean

phoenician.definition:
n. a member of an ancient Semitic people who dominated trade in the first millennium B.C.
n. the extinct language of an ancient Semitic people who dominated trade in the ancient world
a. of or relating to or characteristic of Phoenicia or its inhabitants
phoenician.translation:
a. 腓尼基的, 腓尼基人的
n. 腓尼基人

phoenicians.definition:
plural of Phoenician
n. a member of an ancient Semitic people who dominated trade in the first millennium B.C.
n. the extinct language of an ancient Semitic people who dominated trade in the ancient world
a. of or relating to or characteristic of Phoenicia or its inhabitants
phoenicians.translation:
(Phoenician 的复数) a. 腓尼基的, 腓尼基人的
n. 腓尼基人

phoenicopteridae.translation: [网络] 红鹳科；火烈鸟科；红鹤科

phoenicopterus.definition: n. A genus of birds which includes the flamingoes.

phoenicurus.translation: [网络] 红尾鸲属；援北红尾鸲；贺兰山红尾鸲

phoenix.definition:
n. the state capital and largest city located in south central Arizona; situated in a former desert that has become a prosperous agricultural area thanks to irrigation
n. a large monocotyledonous genus of pinnate-leaved palms found in Asia and Africa
n. a legendary Arabian bird said to periodically burn itself to death and emerge from the ashes as a new phoenix; according to most versions only one phoenix lived at a time and it renewed itself every 500 years
phoenix.translation: n. 凤凰, 不死鸟, 死而复生的人, 完人, 殊品

phoenix dactylifera.translation: [网络] 海枣；枣椰树；枣椰子

phoenix islands.translation: 菲尼克斯群岛；凤凰群岛（基里巴斯三大主要岛群之一）

phoenixes.translation: n. 凤凰, 长生鸟（神话中的鸟, 在阿拉伯沙漠中, 可活数百年, 然后自焚为灰而再生）( phoenix的复数形式 ); 菲尼克斯 （美国城市）
